description: Extract structured weekly opening hours, live open/closed status, and holiday or special hours from Google Maps places. Look places up directly by URL or Place ID, or discover them with a keyword search.

language.description: Language of the Google Maps labels and status line. Times are normalized to a stable 12-hour clock in the output.
language.sectionDescription: Control the language of the status text, how many places run in parallel, and whether closed places are returned.
language.title: Google Maps language

location.description: Add a town, city, or region to the search query, for example 'Austin, TX'. Leave blank when the query already names the area.
location.title: Location (optional)

maxConcurrency.description: How many place pages are requested at the same time in Places mode. Higher values finish large batches faster.
maxConcurrency.title: Places processed in parallel

maxResults.description: How many ranked places to read in Search mode. Smaller runs finish faster and cost less.
maxResults.title: Maximum places in Search mode

mode.description: Choose 'Places' to read specific place URLs or Place IDs, or 'Search' to find places by keyword and read their hours.
mode.sectionDescription: Read a known list of places, or discover places with a search query.
mode.title: What to scrape

openNowOnly.description: When on, places that Google reports as closed, or whose live state is unknown, are excluded from the dataset.
openNowOnly.title: Only return places open right now

placeIds.description: Canonical Google Place IDs beginning with ChIJ. Each ID always points to the same place, which is ideal for monitoring a fixed list.
placeIds.title: Google Place IDs

placeUrls.description: Google Maps place URLs to read. Paste one URL or a batch; short maps.app.goo.gl links are resolved too.
placeUrls.sectionDescription: Used when 'What to scrape' is Places. Provide URLs, Place IDs, or both.
placeUrls.title: Place URLs

searchQuery.description: What to search for, for example 'coffee shops in New York' or 'dentists near me'. Required in Search mode.
searchQuery.sectionDescription: Used when 'What to scrape' is Search. Google Maps ranks the places and the actor reads each place's hours.
searchQuery.title: Search query

title: Google Maps Business Hours Scraper
